body.statement: The finite categorical identification result of \cite{MiaoGengTchetgen2018} assumes that the relevant proxy probability matrices have rank equal to the number of latent categories; a rank-deficient common proxy kernel is outside that full-rank guarantee.

source.locator: Theorem 1 and the categorical-proxy matrix-rank specialization

attestation.note: The primary article DOI and theorem locator support the stated boundary of its finite categorical guarantee.
